B01003_001E population. B11001_001E total households. B19013_001E median household income. B25046_001E aggregate vehicles available.

B11001_001E for 94401-94404 is 13026, 10125, 16414, and 14717. Those are the published 2024 ACS 5-year estimates (data.census.gov table ACSDT5Y2024.B11001, read 2026-11-09). Occupied housing units (B25003_001E) match B11001 for 94402.
B25077_001E median home value. 2000001 is the Census top-code and means $2,000,000 or more.
S0801_C01_046E is mean travel time to work in minutes for workers who did not work from home.
